column4: Same camera and scale as the reference pose. She performs a stiff puppet curtsey: both hands pinch the hem of the skirt and lift it out to the sides, one foot crossed behind the other, knees bent, head bowed. Three-quarter front view. Full-body view of the same porcelain maid doll as in the reference sheet and the approved devotional pose: same face, long orange hair, orange flower ornament with white center, black dress with white apron and ruffles, white boots, ball joints and wrist rings. Exactly two arms, two legs, two feet and five fingers per hand; no strings, no controller, no floor, no shadow. The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140) with nothing else in it; the figure has a clean closed outline against it. The whole figure fits the frame with a small margin.
